content: Kɨxeme 'uitɨwame hurukɨ mɨwewiya meta huriwu hutatɨ
Merikɨtsɨ niuki tuayame nehamatɨa mɨtikuxatakai tawarita kaninuani, hikɨ kanenanutahɨtɨani, xewitɨ kutsutɨ manutahɨtɨarieni hepaɨ.

Hikɨ mɨpaɨ kanetiniuta'iwawiya: «¿Tita petixeiya?» Ne mɨpaɨ nekatinita'eiya: «Xeime kɨxeme 'uitɨwame huru mɨtse'ikɨ wewiyakame nepɨxeiya, yuheima peixeiya xakɨ hepaɨ 'aneme 'e'akunime, kɨxeme 'uitɨwame heima puye'u 'atahutatɨ kɨxeme, meta yunanari pexeiya 'atahutame.
'Aurienata pɨti'u hutatɨ huriwu, xewitɨ xakɨ hepaɨ mɨ'ane tserieta, xewitɨta 'utatana».
Hikɨ niuki tuayame mɨpaɨ nekatiniuta'iwawiya nehamatɨa mɨtikuxatakai: «¿Neti'aitɨwame, tita ti'inɨariyari 'ikɨ naitɨ?»
Niuki tuayame mɨpaɨ kanetiniutahɨawe: «¿Kamɨtsɨ 'atsipekatimate tita mɨti'inɨariyari?» Ne yaneputayɨ kename 'atsinekatimate.
Hikɨ niuki tuayame mɨpaɨ kanetiniutahɨawe: «'Ikɨ Yawé kaniniukieyatɨni Tsuruwaweri hetsiemieme kanihɨkɨtɨni:
Hikɨta niuki tuayame mɨpaɨ nekatiniuta'iwawiya: «¿Tita ti'inɨariyari 'ikɨ huriwu hutatɨ xewitɨ kɨxeme tserieta mutiwe meta 'utatanata xewitɨ?»
Metatsiere mɨpaɨ nekatinita'iwawiya: «¿Tita ti'inɨariyari 'ikɨ hutatɨ huriwu xawariteya hatseiti nanayari hurukɨ mɨwewiyatɨka muhuta 'aurie muti'u, taɨtana muhapane hatseiti hurumaɨyetɨ?»
Niuki tuayame mɨpaɨ kanetiniuta'eiya: «¿Kamɨtsɨ 'atsipekatimate ketita mɨti'inɨariyarite?» Ne yanepetayɨ kename 'atsinekatimate.
Hikɨ niuki tuayame mɨpaɨ kanetiniutaxatɨani: «'Ikɨ yuhutatɨ memanayexeiyarie mekanihɨkɨtɨni ti'aitame memɨte'uximayatsirie naitsarie kwiepa».
